about:
Premier Packaging Inc was founded in 1986 in Charlotte, North Carolina, as a family-owned business. The company began by selling retail bags and has since expanded its product line to serve the food and industrial packaging markets.

Today, Premier Packaging offers a range of packaging products, including the FiberFlow and FiberForm lines, along with a suite of technical services. These services encompass product selection and application engineering, in-person and virtual sales support, sample provision for customer testing, plant trial participation to optimize performance, and technical machine support backed by a specialist who previously served as head engineer for 15 years at a leading film machinery manufacturer.

The company serves customers in food packaging and industrial packaging sectors, working directly with sales teams and end users to identify the correct size, material, or alternative solution for their applications.

Premier Packaging emphasizes its long-standing industry experience and hands-on technical expertise as key differentiators, combining decades of packaging knowledge with specialized machinery support to help customers certify and optimize their packaging processes.
